hypothesis: Change only the swarm communication topology from global-best to fixed radius-one ring local-best: each particle is socially attracted to the highest-scoring personal-best position held by itself or its two persistent ring neighbors, so an early all-swarm winner propagates locally instead of immediately steering every trajectory.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder on randomized and canonicalized SMILES views of the allowed unlabeled corpus, then freeze its encoder and decoder. At the start of each independent objective session, encode the ten fixed scored initial molecules as ten persistent particles with latent velocities and personal-best memories. After every oracle response, update the personal and swarm-best memories, move each particle by the Molecular Swarm Optimization rule combining inertia with stochastic attraction toward its own best and the swarm's current and historical best positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule from each resulting trajectory for the next announced batch. Oracle scores therefore steer interacting de novo latent trajectories directly, without fitting a surrogate or selecting from the corpus, and the 290 adaptive calls are concentrated on finding an exceptional terminal molecule for final Top-1.

activation_observables.measurement: For every particle move, record the fixed predecessor/self/successor identifiers, all three pre-move personal-best scores, positions and rounds, the deterministically selected local-best identifier and position, both unchanged social random vectors and weights, and both realized social components. Reconstruct the selection and velocity terms exactly, then report per round the number of distinct local exemplars and the fraction of moves whose social exemplar differs from at least one contemporaneous Parent-style current or historical all-swarm exemplar. The Parent reference has one globally broadcast exemplar per social term and zero moves driven by a ring-specific alternative; activation requires zero reconstruction errors, more than one distinct local exemplar on eligible rounds, and a positive pooled different-from-global fraction.

applicability_conditions: Persistent particle identity and cyclic ordering remain stable across the objective session, and accepted oracle scores continue to update finite, comparable personal-best memories before the next move.

The objective has multiple useful latent basins or an early globally best particle is not reliably the basin that should steer all ten trajectories; benefit may be limited on a smooth unimodal objective where immediate global communication is efficient.
Radius-one neighborhoods retain more than one distinct best personal memory for enough of the 29 adaptive rounds to slow winner propagation without completely removing social information sharing.

The frozen encoder-decoder preserves enough association between separated latent trajectories and decoded chemistry for increased latent spread to yield meaningfully different valid molecules rather than only stochastic variants of one basin.

The unchanged bounded decoder retry path continues to fill all ten particle slots with canonical novel molecules; local trajectories that move into weak decoder support could erase any exploration benefit.

Current evidence is limited to screening seed 0, and the Parent's persistent decoded scaffold diversity means latent contraction is only a plausible limiting behavior until this paired topology intervention measures its mediation and score effect.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any move uses a social target other than the deterministically best personal-best memory in that particle's fixed three-member ring, if the logged social components cannot be reconstructed from that target with the unchanged weights and random vectors, or if the pooled fraction of moves using a ring-specific alternative to the global exemplars is zero. If those wiring checks pass but paired post-move mean pairwise latent distance does not increase over n-225f7793840c, the proposed local-communication anti-synchronization mediation is falsified even though the code path executed.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the prepared frozen autoencoder, persistent particle ordering, seeded positions and velocities, personal-best updates, both existing social weights and independent random coefficient vectors, clipping, one-proposal-per-particle decoding, canonicalization, duplicate rejection, and bounded fallbacks unchanged. Fix each particle's neighborhood to its predecessor, itself, and successor in the original cyclic particle order. Before every synchronized move, select that neighborhood's best personal-best memory by descending finite score with personal-best round and particle identifier as deterministic tie breakers, then use the selected local-best position in place of both the Parent's current all-swarm-best and historical all-swarm-best positions in the otherwise identical two social velocity terms. Retain the global memories for unchanged feedback auditing and comparison diagnostics, and log each fixed neighborhood, its personal-best snapshot, the selected local exemplar, its relationship to both global exemplars, and the exact resulting social components.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-225f7793840c broadcasts the same current-swarm and historical-swarm winners to all ten particles, and that strong global social pressure synchronizes the latent search. Its 1,422 eligible moves all received nonzero exemplar attraction with mean signed projection lift 0.878941552680506, while mean pairwise latent distance contracted from 4.945978128810501 at initialization to a five-task terminal mean of 0.8469770757256736. Although 8 to 10 decoded scaffolds persisted per round, only 29 adaptive rounds are available and the Parent's two weakest final Top-1 values were 0.19048685603364754 on median_2 and 0.2357712026556461 on sitagliptin_mpo. The limiting behavior is therefore premature latent synchronization around globally broadcast winners, not absent feedback pressure or failure to fill valid novel batches.

applicability_conditions: Stable particle identity, cyclic ordering, and finite comparable personal memories are supported here: all 1,450 moves preserve p000-p009, all 4,350 neighborhood memory rows are finite and consistent with the particles' own histories, and all 145 feedback records have consistency rate 1.0 with zero complete-memory audit errors.

Radius-one neighborhoods retained several distinct leaders throughout these batch-10, 29-round sessions: every one of 145 rounds had 4-7 distinct selected local exemplars, and 93.79310344827586% of moves used a local memory different from at least one contemporaneous global comparator.

The anti-synchronization mediation is supported on every evaluated task: candidate mean pairwise latent distance exceeded its paired Parent checkpoint after every one of 145 moves, not only at termination. This evidence applies to fixed radius one, ten particles, the inherited social weights, and the evaluated 48-dimensional representation.

The unchanged bounded decoder path remained operational despite lower yield: all ten identities contributed to all 145 candidate batches, producing 1,450 unique valid molecules from 5,587 attempts with zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate proposals; the hardest round used 185 attempts, well below the inherited cap.

Association between latent separation and decoded chemical diversity is not supported broadly by this replica. Canonical counts remained complete, but scaffold counts were usually unchanged and slightly lower in aggregate, so applications requiring extra latent spread to produce extra chemotypes need stronger decoder-locality evidence.

A terminal-score benefit is supported only narrowly on deco_hop and median_2 in seed 0 and is contradicted on the remaining three tasks. Applicability is therefore limited when rapid all-swarm exploitation is valuable, rewarding basins are effectively unimodal, or a strong discovery must reach all particles within 29 rounds.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and does not establish multi-seed reliability, other swarm sizes or ring radii, tighter decoder retry limits, or objectives whose useful chemistry lies outside the inherited frozen decoder's support.

observable_measurements.value: All 150 candidate and 150 Parent spread checkpoints pair exactly by task and round. Their shared initialization has mean pairwise latent distance 4.945978128810501, minimum pairwise distance 3.2528404725823052, ten canonical molecules, and ten Bemis-Murcko scaffolds. Across all 145 paired post-move checkpoints, candidate-minus-Parent mean pairwise distance was positive in 145/145 cases (fraction 1.0), with pooled arithmetic mean 1.967881240433934 and range 0.45826605491137773 to 2.7040408677841663. Each task was positive on all 29 rounds; task-level mean changes were zaleplon_mpo 2.2836413711933687, deco_hop 1.71909371325425, drd2_docking 1.5816545748197897, median_2 2.0434882209064424, and sitagliptin_mpo 2.2115283219958184. Candidate terminal mean pairwise distances were respectively 3.00302734896863, 2.1991530213056056, 2.425805083332294, 2.5708833322250024, and 3.2259066253420565; their average 2.6849550822347177 exceeds the Parent terminal average 0.8469770757256736 by 1.8379780065090443. Candidate terminal mean distance to the historical global best averaged 1.9739749529306625 versus 0.7067049666014329 for the Parent. The higher mean spread coexisted with closer local pairs: terminal minimum pairwise distance averaged 0.24232118385796358 versus the Parent's 0.5232076798293949. Every candidate and Parent post-move batch retained ten unique canonical molecules. Candidate scaffold count ranged from 7 to 10 versus the Parent's 8 to 10; paired scaffold-count change averaged -0.1103448275862069, with 12 positive, 112 unchanged, and 21 negative checkpoints. Terminal candidate-versus-Parent scaffold counts were zaleplon_mpo 10 versus 9, deco_hop 10 versus 10, drd2_docking 10 versus 10, median_2 10 versus 10, and sitagliptin_mpo 8 versus 10. Thus the preregistered anti-synchronization mediator increased decisively, while the diagnostic chemotype counts show that the extra latent separation did not generally become extra scaffold diversity.

possible_failure_causes: The extra latent separation did not survive frozen decoding as broader scaffolds: all 145 batches still contained ten unique molecules, but candidate-minus-Parent scaffold count averaged -0.1103448275862069 and sitagliptin_mpo ended with 8 rather than 10 scaffolds. This is consistent with separated latent trajectories decoding to stochastic variants within the same chemotypes, although this node does not isolate decoder geometry from task-specific trajectory effects.

The ring may preserve exploration at the expense of transmitting and exploiting a strong global discovery within only 29 adaptive rounds. The trusted seed-0 summaries report candidate macro 0.290077165602972 versus Parent 0.475756821984013; candidate Top-1 improved on deco_hop and median_2 but fell sharply on drd2_docking and sitagliptin_mpo. The paired activation evidence establishes the topology and mediation, but cannot separate slow winner propagation from single-seed sampling as the cause of those score losses.

Higher overall spread was uneven: candidate terminal mean pairwise distance averaged 2.6849550822347177 while terminal minimum pairwise distance averaged only 0.24232118385796358, below the Parent's 0.5232076798293949. The ring therefore left some close local groups alongside distant particles rather than maintaining uniformly separated searches; this clustering may spend trajectories redundantly while withholding the best global direction from other groups.

The local trajectories required 5,587 decoder attempts for 1,450 emissions versus 4,884 for the Parent, and the hardest candidate round used 185 attempts versus 101. Every batch still completed, so decoder support did not operationally fail, but movement into weaker frozen-decoder support could consume more runtime or fail under a tighter retry allowance.

Only screening seed 0 was evaluated. It decisively establishes mechanism activation and the predicted intermediate spread shift for this replica, but not multi-seed score reliability or a generally beneficial exploration-exploitation balance.
